description: Angular component for polygon settings in a widget map, including form controls, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: PolygonSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring polygon settings in a map widget, with form validation and dynamic control enabling/disabling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and updates validators.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on component disabled state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided PolygonSettings value and updates validators.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on current form values.
